#pragma once
#include <optional>
#include <vector>
namespace policy = ::mmltk::frameworks::reflection;
struct TrainingSourceCatalog {
 [[= ::policy::MaxItems{kTrainingSourceCapacity}]] std::vector<MetricSource> available;
 [[= ::mmltk::frameworks::reflection::MaxItems{
   kMaximumTrainingModels + 1U}]] std::vector<Failure> failures;
 [[= ::policy::MaxBytes{64}]][[= ::policy::MinBytes{1}]] std::string identity = "MMLTK_MAX_BYTES(99)";
 [[= ::policy::MaxBytes{::policy::kMaximumPathBytes}]] std::filesystem::path directory;
 [[= ::policy::Minimum<double>{0.0}]][[= ::policy::Maximum<double>{1.0}]][[= ::policy::Finite{}]] double fraction = 0.5;
 [[= ::policy::CatalogProvider<Catalog<int, float>>{}]] int selection = 0;
 [[= ::policy::MaxItems{std::integral_constant<std::size_t, 2>::value}]] std::optional<std::vector<int>> values;
 MMLTK_MAX_BYTES(4) std::string already;
 bool operator==(const TrainingSourceCatalog&) const = default;
};
MMLTK_REFLECT_FIELDS(TrainingSourceCatalog)
[[nodiscard]] int inspect(const TrainingSourceCatalog&) noexcept;
// [[= policy::MaxBytes{99}]] is an example, not a declaration.
const auto literal = R"raw(
#if SOMETHING
[[= policy::MaxBytes{99}]]
#define MMLTK_MAX_BYTES(X) broken
)raw";
#define EXAMPLE [[= policy::MaxBytes{99}]]
